claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 May 1866, p. 4, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Java, Captain Moodie, which
left Liverpool at eleven o'clock on the morning of the
5th and Queenstown on the afternoon of the 6th of May,
arrived at this port yesterday morning.
The news is two days later than the report of the Mora-
vian, off Father Point, published in the HERALD on Tues-
day morning.
